issues.reason: The atom is true of the sentence's content given the parse's own (Member sk_slick_1 essence): the slick IS the poor essence, so predicating poor of it asserts nothing the text denies — and the objection is to improvisation in territory the instruction set leaves uncovered, since it excludes a measure of-phrase ("a cup of water") from Possession without supplying a replacement.

This mistakes a coverage gap for a defect: no head is licensed for an INDEFINITE portion of-phrase (PartOf's mass-partitive use needs a definite whole, Possession is explicitly barred for a measure), and the typing chosen mirrors the licensed Partitives shape "a part of a homogeneous mass is still that mass" — every emitted atom is true and well-typed, and nothing is missing that the instruction set requires.

gaps_confirmed: A portion / quantity noun with a bare-MASS of-phrase ("a thin slick of poor essence", the "a cup of water" shape) has no licensed encoding: Possession is explicitly excluded for a measure, the mass-partitive PartOf / ProportionOf route needs a definite whole, and Measure needs a stated magnitude and unit.
new_gaps: With no head for the portion relation, the of-phrase's own modifier ("poor") has nowhere to attach except the portion's symbol, so a scope distinction the sentence makes — "thin" on the slick, "poor" on the essence — is unrecoverable in any licensed form; a licensed encoding would need to carry the mass referent and its modifiers separately from the portion's.
notes: The remaining atoms hold: the indefinite subject of a verbal predicate takes a witness rather than a generic, the inanimate transitive subject stays Agent, yield brings its object into existence so Patient is right, and the habitual present correctly carries no status atom. Fusing hard_boil (term-of-art reading) and exposing its gradable modifier genus is a judgment call the compound rules permit.
